description: Gift Booking State Machine - Replace manual gift status updates with centralized state machine, add auto-expiration, and create audit trail

userStories.title: Create GiftState enum and database schema updates
userStories.description: Add state machine infrastructure to the database schema
acceptanceCriteria: Create GiftState enum in schema.prisma with states: PENDING, SENT, ACCEPTED, DECLINED, EXPIRED
Add giftStateChangedAt DateTime field to Booking model for last state transition timestamp
Add giftExpiresAt DateTime field to Booking model (calculated as giftDeliveryDate + 30 days or createdAt + 30 days)
Create GiftStateTransition model to track state history: id, bookingId, fromState, toState, reason, metadata (JSON), createdAt
Add foreign key relationship from GiftStateTransition to Booking
Run prisma generate and create migration
All existing tests pass (npm run test)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Keep existing GiftStatus enum for backwards compatibility during migration. The new GiftState enum adds EXPIRED state. Migration should set giftExpiresAt for existing gifts.

userStories.title: Create gift state machine helper with transition validation
userStories.description: Build centralized state machine logic similar to payment-state-machine.ts
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/gift/gift-state-machine.ts with GiftStateMachine class
Define valid transitions: PENDING→SENT, SENT→ACCEPTED, SENT→DECLINED, SENT→EXPIRED, PENDING→EXPIRED
Implement canTransition(fromState, toState): boolean method
Implement getValidTransitions(currentState): GiftState[] method
Implement isTerminalState(state): boolean (ACCEPTED, DECLINED, EXPIRED are terminal)
Implement getTransitionReason(fromState, toState): string method for audit logging
Add transition metadata support (who triggered, why, additional context)
Create comprehensive unit tests (minimum 20 tests covering all transitions and edge cases)
Export singleton instance for use across codebase
All tests pass (npm run test)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Follow the same pattern as lib/payments/payment-state-machine.ts. Include tests for invalid transitions throwing errors.

userStories.title: Create gift state transition service
userStories.description: Service layer that executes state transitions with side effects
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/gift/gift-transition-service.ts
Implement transitionGiftState(bookingId, toState, reason, metadata) async function
Validate transition is allowed using GiftStateMachine before executing
Record transition in GiftStateTransition table for audit trail
Update booking.giftStatus and booking.giftStateChangedAt atomically
Handle SENT transition: send gift notification email to recipient
Handle DECLINED transition: initiate Stripe refund, update booking status to CANCELLED
Handle EXPIRED transition: initiate Stripe refund, update booking status to CANCELLED, send expiration notice to purchaser
Handle ACCEPTED transition: transfer booking ownership, send confirmation emails
All operations wrapped in database transaction for atomicity
Create unit tests mocking external services (email, Stripe)
All tests pass (npm run test)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Use existing email templates. Reuse refund logic from current gift.ts decline handler. Ensure idempotency for retries.

userStories.title: Refactor gift router to use state machine
userStories.description: Update lib/trpc/server/routers/gift.ts to use centralized state machine
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor acceptGift procedure to use giftTransitionService.transitionGiftState()
Refactor declineGift procedure to use giftTransitionService.transitionGiftState()
Remove manual status update code (direct prisma updates to giftStatus)
Add validation that checks state machine before attempting transition
Return meaningful error messages for invalid transitions
Update getByToken to include state transition history in response
All existing gift.test.ts tests continue to pass
Add new tests for state machine error cases (invalid transitions)
All tests pass (npm run test)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: This is a refactor - behavior should remain the same but now use state machine. Focus on maintaining backwards compatibility.

userStories.title: Create auto-expiration cron job
userStories.description: Cron job to automatically expire gifts that pass their expiration date
acceptanceCriteria: Create app/api/cron/expire-gifts/route.ts
Find all gifts where giftStatus=SENT and giftExpiresAt <= now
Transition each to EXPIRED state using giftTransitionService
Send expiration notification email to purchaser
Process in batches of 10 to avoid timeout
Log all expirations for monitoring
Add Vercel cron config to run daily at 10:00 AM UTC
Create unit tests with mocked database and services
All tests pass (npm run test)
TypeScript strict mode: 0 errors
userStories.notes: Similar pattern to charge-installments cron. Use 30-day expiration window (configurable). Include metrics tracking if time permits.

Replace direct giftStatus update with giftTransitionService.transitionGiftState()
Calculate and set giftExpiresAt when transitioning to SENT (deliveryDate + 30 days)

userStories.notes: Refactor existing cron, don't create new one. Ensure giftExpiresAt is set correctly for time-based expiration.
